prompts.ai_head: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent raster illustration for a mobile hackathon card, NOT a screen or poster. Primary request: a realistic human head in left-facing profile and slight three-quarter view, made exclusively from extremely fine triangulated wireframe edges and point-cloud particles. Cranium, nose, lips and chin must read clearly. Neon magenta #E91DF4 on the face and neck, limited icy cyan #63D8FF at the back of the skull. Dark translucent interior, no solid skin. Subtle local glow with crisp visible tiny triangles. Head and short neck centered, fully visible with generous transparent margins, square image. It must remain a strong readable silhouette when shown at 150px wide. No text, no words, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no frame, no scenic background. Genuine alpha transparency.
